name: claude plugin eval in CI for v8's skills
summary: An advisory CI job that runs claude plugin eval on v8's own skills, to catch regressions the fixture tests miss. The native runner loads only the plugin, runs each case 3 times and reports means and deltas, with no intervals (inferred from the docs). Costs CI tokens; fixture tests are the simpler alternative.

evidence.setting: Documentation; needs Claude Code 2.1.269 or later
evidence.effect: Runs each case 3 times by default, loads only the plugin under test, reports means and deltas, and runs Bash under the OS sandbox

killTest.hypothesis: Native plugin evals catch regressions fixtures miss
killTest.pass: At least one such regression in 3 months
killTest.scheduled: 3 months from when the advisory CI job is added; no start date set

maintenance: Owned CI job, maintained with the engine.
